exposure: FGR diagnosis (true positive vs. false positive)
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 352 pregnancies diagnosed with suspected fetal growth restriction (FGR) between August 2016 and January 2019.
finding: First trimester abdominal circumference <3rd centile had the highest sensitivity (81.9%) for detecting FGR, while estimated fetal weight <3rd centile had the highest specificity (83.2%).
